title: USS Delarov disc rises from sea near Adak

tellings.quote: that, but other people did see it emerge from the water. It's a discshaped object about 200 feet in diameter.

plain: In 1945, near Adak Island in Alaska's Aleutian chain, people aboard a US Navy ship called the USS Delarov are said to have watched a disc-shaped object about 200 feet across rise out of the sea. The researcher Richard Dolan tells it second-hand, passing on what he credits to a witness named Robert Crawford and to James McDonald, a scientist who looked into UFO reports. If true, it would put a large craft coming out of the ocean two years before the UFO wave of the late 1940s.
